status: REJECTED. Isolated lab candidate, not production.
verdict: Body collapses into an unreadable mass from 1.00 s. The grip does not hold: at rest the fingers hang below the shaft, at death frame 30 the hand leaves the staff. The rear ring stays rigid. Three severe edges remain.
holds: Rear ring stays rigid and full scale, bound to Head only
Floor contact passes: death body minimum 0.84 mm, prop minimum 45 mm
The other five clips have zero severe edges
fails: Three edges stretch past 4x from frame 26.4 to 44, all at the trunk-to-arm and skirt-to-arm boundary
Palm-point coincidence is not a grip; the finger vertices have no bones and hang below the shaft
Non-death clips changed from the pivot move: attack 0.159 m, cast 0.256 m, hurt 0.082 m, walk 0.024 m, none visually accepted
blocker: The skirt, torso and right arm share vertices across Spine, Chest, RightShoulder and RightUpperArm. The same vertices cannot follow both a collapsing torso and an arm. The hand is a single bone, so the palm triangle can be pinned to the shaft point but the fingers cannot close around it.
decision: Stop parameter work on this mesh. A credible robe collapse and a finger grip both need topology this mesh does not have: a skirt shell whose vertices are not shared with the arm, and a hand with finger bones. No paid generation is authorised. The next trial, if started, is a bounded topology edit on an isolated copy.
